‼️Huge news! After Trump's federal funding freeze prevented Prisma Community Care in Phoenix from accessing grant funds they needed to do their work, my team and I worked with HHS to restore their funding.

Now, thousands of Arizonans can access critical care like HIV treatment.

Trump and Republicans want to rip away your health care with their cruel budget proposal that would cut Medicaid. That means parents and grandparents without home care, new mothers unable to access postpartum treatment, and children without a lifeline. https://t.co/tgDRPDORh2

Federal workers like Joshua make sure rural Arizonans have clean drinking water and safe hospitals.

Laid off by DOGE, the 100 projects he oversees are at risk. https://t.co/sdL1oSBqgq

I was sickened by the testimonies I heard today of inhumane treatment at the Eloy ICE Detention Center. 

I’ll be taking this straight to the Trump Administration, demanding answers and more independent oversight. https://t.co/wUGgz8ToQR

More than 365,000 people in Arizona will be kicked off of healthcare outright because of Republicans' Big Ugly Bill–but thousands more people will lose care when rural hospitals across our state close.

Healthcare should be a human right, not a privilege. https://t.co/D7yEoxXWsn

Unlike Republicans, Democrats are fighting for the healthcare of working families. 

We’re pushing to repeal Trump’s Big Ugly Bill cuts to Medicaid, stopping the closure of nursing homes and hospitals, and protecting coverage for 15M Americans—including kids, seniors, and people with disabilities.

https://t.co/Fa63I9Pjve

I voted NO on the GOP CR because it rips health care away from Arizonans—including patients served by @ValledelSolAZ.

Trump refuses to meet with Democrats because he thinks he’s a King. Republicans run Congress. A shutdown would be 100% on them. https://t.co/GZivCVpyJt

The Trump shutdown is authoritarian politics hurting real people. Tonight I heard from a teacher struggling with healthcare costs, a senior worried about Social Security, parents fearing ICE. We’re fighting back. https://t.co/sIH6pgnzWK

Proud to stand with @LUCHA_AZ, Democratic and labor leaders to call out Trump and Republicans for their reckless shutdown and the health care crisis they created.

300K+ Arizonans could lose coverage. Premiums are doubling. People will die. We won’t back down. https://t.co/MAXNyJUS39
Appreciate @CaptMarkKelly for saying it plainly. When healthcare premiums go up, families suffer. Republicans can’t spin, distract, or scapegoat their way out of that.

When Trump and Republicans claim undocumented immigrants get federal health care, they’re lying. It’s a distraction from the fact that they’re ripping health care away from 17 million Americans — and your premiums are about to double or worse. https://t.co/EDDuPm1YXg

In Arizona, families like Jennifer’s depend on Medicaid for their children’s care. But Trump and Republicans are manufacturing a health care crisis that puts them at risk.

Jennifer—and millions like her—are counting on us to fight back. https://t.co/RgWoF9uG8j

Today is #WorldMentalHealthDay — and none of us are immune.

I’ve dealt with anxiety myself, and I know how hard it can be to find support when you need it.

That’s why I joined @RepBonnie  to introduce the Mental Health Emergency Package—three bills that strengthen crisis response, expand care, and save lives.

Because people in crisis deserve care, not criminalization. 💚

If you or someone you know is struggling, call or text 988 for free, confidential help.

Celebrating Native heritage all weekend ahead of #IndigenousPeoplesDay on Monday — from the Downtown Phoenix Night Market to Native Health’s Open House and Health Fair.

See what’s going on in #AZ03 ⬇️ https://t.co/fNb5ILemIj

‼️ It’s Day 12 of the Trump Shutdown.‼️ Millions of Americans across the country are now receiving notices with massive premium increases because of the Republican health care crisis. 

Yet @SpeakerJohnson wants @HouseGOP to stay on vacation. Make that make sense? https://t.co/K2mgIXwyJN

While we wait for Trump and Republicans to work with us to end their shutdown and fix the health care crisis they’ve created, my office is a resource to serve you. 

Please reach out to us at https://t.co/aI5lm9mA0r https://t.co/khQV2iTc2B

Proud to have hosted my first Veterans’ Advisory Board meeting last month. Now, VA services are at risk because of the Trump-Republican shutdown.

While Republicans keep our government in limbo, veterans can reach out to my office for assistance with the VA, Medicare & more. https://t.co/UvpBrdcVkd

I called my constituents to hear directly how the Trump and Republican health care crisis and government shutdown are hurting our community. They have a few thoughts for @SpeakerJohnson. https://t.co/Tf3GExSBEv

As the youngest woman in Congress, I know who pays the price when the government fails: we do. Women.

While Trump and Republicans take vacations, we’re here fighting to reopen the government and protect our healthcare. https://t.co/iw0TosUbS7

Week 4 of the Trump-Republican shutdown. Trump & @SpeakerJohnson are betraying 34,460 federal workers in Arizona who are furloughed or working without pay — & more than 300,000 Arizonans impacted by their healthcare crisis. 

I’m proud to stand with @AFGEnational & fight for them.

Republicans are still on vacation while @SEIU workers in Arizona like Raul and Ezra at @PHXSkyHarbor are worried about affording healthcare and keeping a roof over their heads.

Democrats are at the negotiating table. Will @SpeakerJohnson and Republicans finally show up? https://t.co/xpK0Ti0pbG

My constituent Yari, who has cancer, has been detained since Feb 10, and her health has deteriorated severely.

Proud to stand with Trans Queer Pueblo and grassroots orgs today demanding her release. I’ll never stop fighting for Yari & every person suffering at the hands of ICE. https://t.co/IwtON9SZ0d
Tune in at 8pm ET—I’ll be on with @chrislhayes to talk about Trump’s $300 million ballroom, bankrolled by billionaires and corporations, while millions of Americans lose healthcare.

While millions of Americans are missing paychecks and losing health care, Donald Trump is building himself a $350 million palace funded by corporations and billionaires buying influence. It’s disgusting. 

I’m demanding answers with @RepRobertGarcia and @RepHuffman. https://t.co/2cdUSR9YsK

After our office demanded that ICE allow Yari to see an oncologist for her cancer, they finally did. Now they’re withholding her medical results.

This is unacceptable. Yari is in critical condition. We demand her release and immediate treatment now. https://t.co/tSFQsX188T
